canonical_project: Africell Data Center, Freetown (seafront, Lumley Beach Road)
notes: Groundbreaking for Africell's seafront data centre at 30F Lumley Beach Road, Freetown (Jun 2022, per DCD and Construction Review Online); intended first as Africell's disaster-recovery centre, later open to third-party infrastructure and possibly a second subsea cable. A later DFC delegation visit photo shows the state-of-the-art centre under construction. No confirmed operational status found - status kept construction.
